name: config_root_help
stdout:
Usage: bijux config [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Manage CLI configuration.

Options:
  -q, --quiet             Suppress normal output; exit code still indicates
                          success/failure.
  -v, --verbose           Include extra runtime details.
  -f, --format TEXT       Machine‑readable output format (json|yaml); defaults
                          to json.  [default: json]
  --pretty / --no-pretty  Disable pretty‑printing (indentation) in JSON/YAML
                          output.  [default: pretty]
  -d, --debug             Enable diagnostics to stderr.
  -h, --help              Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  clear   Clears all configuration settings from the active store.
  export  Exports the current configuration to a file or standard output.
  get     Retrieves the value for a given configuration key.
  list    Lists all configuration keys from the active configuration store.
  load    Loads configuration from a specified file.
  reload  Reloads the configuration from disk and emits a structured result.
  set     Sets or updates a configuration key-value pair.
  unset   Removes a key from the active configuration store.
